statements.impact_statement: CVE-2015-3276 is a cipher-string parsing flaw in nss_parse_ciphers() in libraries/libldap/tls_m.c, the Mozilla NSS TLS backend of OpenLDAP's libldap, which could select a weaker cipher than configured (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2015-3276). That backend is not in the code this owner ships. OpenLDAP 2.6.10, which the DHI openldap package for Debian 13 builds from Debian's 2.6.10+dfsg-1, has no tls_m.c; its libldap TLS backends are tls_g.c (GnuTLS) and tls_o.c (OpenSSL) (https://github.com/openldap/openldap/tree/OPENLDAP_REL_ENG_2_6_10/libraries/libldap). In both published builds of this package for amd64 and arm64, libldap.so.2 links libssl.so.3 and libcrypto.so.3 and no NSS library, and neither it nor the static libldap.a contains nss_parse_ciphers or any other NSS backend function; the archive's TLS members are tls2.o, tls_g.o and tls_o.o.
